config_a.name: cardiac_quadratic_reference_halfstep_ew_coarse_v1
config_a.scope: Prospective P2/Q6/0.625ms GMRES/GAMG with native Eisenstat-Walker version2(initial linear rtol0.01/max0.1), restart200/cap3000, strict1e-8N absolute/zero-relative stopping and100 Newton ceiling. No direct fallback. Both mesh levels use identical fixed solver settings. Coarse starts from rest; refined inherits452 accepted states plus two independently audited EW recovery states through0.28375s, with complete provenance; inherited states are not re-executed. Each nonlinear iterate is saved separately as UNACCEPTED. Native convergence, full-cycle whole-element positivity and independent norm checks gate any matched mesh result. Q6 integration uncertainty remains unresolved. No neural retraining or continuum claim.
